faq.title: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
faq.desc: We're here to answer all your questions and provide clarity on every stage of your project's cost and commercial management.

items.q: How do I request a construction cost estimate?
items.a: Submit the form above with your project details. Our Quantity Surveying team will review the information and follow up with an initial cost assessment.

items.q: Do you provide an instant cost calculator?
items.a: No — construction pricing depends on too many project-specific factors to be reduced to a simple calculation. We review each submission individually before providing an assessment.

items.q: What types of projects do you advise on?
items.a: Residential, commercial, hospitality, marine, infrastructure and mixed-use developments across the UAE.

items.q: Do you offer claims and dispute support?
items.a: Yes — including claims preparation and review, quantum assessment, expert witness reports, and support through negotiation, arbitration and adjudication.

items.q: Can you support projects that are already under construction?
items.a: Yes. We provide commercial and contract management, cost control, and project advisory services at any stage of the project lifecycle.

items.q: How quickly will I hear back after submitting a request?
items.a: Our team typically reviews and responds to cost estimate requests within a few business days, depending on project complexity.
